title: Real TTS Model Integration
description: Replace TTS stub backends with real model inference (Kokoro, Qwen3-TTS, Fish Speech, Higgs, etc.) so the Auritus player generates actual speech. Fix worker token refresh. Test locally without deploying each time.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Kokoro (M-TTS-1) and Qwen (M-TTS-2) generate real speech on local workers and AWS Batch. Higgs remains a tone stub. Remaining epic is M-TTS-3 (Fish, real Higgs, XTTS, Kokoro variants).

right_now_summary: Kokoro and Qwen now produce real speech; the team is fixing token refresh and adding more models.
